name: Five Signets for War Supplies
summary: In Ironforge, Field Marshal Snowfall gathers provisions and equipment for the Grand Alliance's war effort. Champions can trade commendation signets for field rations, bandages, and combat supplies. The stockpiles keep those working on the home front equipped for coming conflicts.

sections.title: Supplying the Front
sections.body: Field Marshal Snowfall organizes the flow of materials as one of the Alliance's primary quartermasters in Ironforge. Armies need more than courage; they also need steady supplies for the fronts. Couriers and heroes bring commendation signets earned through civic service, and Snowfall trades them for survival rations and tactical gear.

sections.title: A Pragmatic Trade
sections.body: Royal heralds offer public honor and civic standing for commendation signets. Snowfall offers another choice: trade five signets for field gear, without pomp, glory, or official recognition. The exchange gives soldiers and volunteers practical goods to help keep them alive when marching into hostile lands.

faq.answer: Field Marshal Snowfall is a senior Alliance military officer stationed in Ironforge. As one of the Alliance's primary quartermasters, he gathers materials and distributes supplies to soldiers and adventurers aiding the war effort.
Alliance Commendation Signets are tokens awarded to citizens and adventurers who donate trade goods, bandages, herbs, and ores to support the Alliance's mobilization.

faq.q: Why trade signets for supplies rather than prestige?
faq.answer: Trading signets for supplies provides immediate, practical resources instead of civic reputation. For frontline fighters who need consumables, rations, and bandages, practical gear can matter more than ceremonial standing.

faq.q: Where does this exchange take place?
faq.answer: The exchange takes place in Ironforge, where Field Marshal Snowfall stands near the war staging grounds and supply depots, coordinating shipments across Khaz Modan and beyond.
Yes. Field Marshal Snowfall authorizes more supply bundles whenever you provide five commendation signets.

No. Field Marshal Snowfall explicitly warns that trading signets directly for personal supplies grants no civic recognition or prestige with the Alliance factions; their value comes back as physical goods.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you help keep troops supplied with bandages and rations for major campaigns across Azeroth.
As a dwarf, you can take pride in seeing Ironforge's halls arm all allied races.
